cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(metadata_witness LANGUAGES NONE)
# Execute the unchanged app build graph, substituting only Qt/SDK compilation and
# resource packaging. Metadata producers and their target dependencies stay real.
# This builds no app, fetches no package, and never needs SDK credentials.
function(include file)
    if(NOT file MATCHES "EdiGuiBase\\.cmake$")
        _include(${ARGV})
    endif()
endfunction()
function(find_package)
endfunction()
function(qt_add_library target)
    add_custom_target(${target})
endfunction()
function(qt_add_qml_module target)
    if(NOT TARGET ${target}plugin)
        add_custom_target(${target}plugin)
    endif()
endfunction()
function(qt_add_executable target)
    add_custom_target(${target})
endfunction()
function(qt_add_resources)
endfunction()
function(qt_add_shaders)
endfunction()
function(target_include_directories)
endfunction()
function(target_compile_definitions)
endfunction()
function(target_link_options)
endfunction()
function(target_link_libraries target)
    foreach(dependency IN LISTS ARGN)
        if(TARGET ${dependency})
            add_dependencies(${target} ${dependency})
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()
function(target_sources target)
    # Retain explicit generated-source dependencies without compiling app code.
    foreach(source IN LISTS ARGN)
        if(source MATCHES "^${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/")
            string(MD5 key "${target}:${source}")
            add_custom_target(metadata_source_${key} DEPENDS "${source}")
            add_dependencies(${target} metadata_source_${key})
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()
function(install)
endfunction()
add_subdirectory(app)
